site.tagline: Literacy, mentorship and youth employment on Staten Island
site.description: Urban Hope Inc is a 501(c)(3) on Staten Island's North Shore. One-to-one reading tutoring for grades K–2 in eight public and charter schools, after-school clubs, and paid summer jobs for teenagers.
